Subject: ACME POC — success criteria, access & next steps

Hi Sam / Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed plan for the POC so we have shared success criteria and a clear access plan. Please review and confirm owners/timing.

1) Success criteria (target measurable outcomes)
- Inference latency: end-to-end 95th percentile < 250ms for 512 token requests from your US region.
- Cost: <= $0.002 per 1k tokens for the baseline workload (we'll provide token logs).
- Quality: top-3 prompt set F1 >= 0.85 vs your golden set (we'll ingest your eval prompts).
- Stability: no more than 0.5% error rate over a 24h test window.

2) Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): access provisioning (API key + SSO + IP allowlist) — owner: Marissa (Redwood) and Priya (ACME).
- Week 1: smoke tests + integration of prompts, basic throughput tests (ACME devs).
- Week 2: ramp evaluation with 1k concurrent QPS-like batch (joint run with Redwood ops).
- Week 3: metric review and decision call.

3) Ownership & contacts
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (POC lead), Rishi Malhotra (security/compliance on standby), Vivek Kulkarni (identity & SSO).
- ACME: Priya Singh (technical lead), Sam Turner (product owner).

4) Access we need to provide this week
- SSO invites (Okta) for the ACME evaluation group (Priya, Sam, and two engineers).
- One short-lived API key for integration testing (will rotate after 7 days).
- Optional static IP allowlist if you want to restrict API calls.

I've attached the proposed success criteria doc and the onboarding checklist.

Next steps: please confirm the three ACME emails for SSO and the IPs (if you want allowlisted) and we will provision the API key + SSO invites today.

Best,

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
redwood.ai
